lead.title: Alphabet sheds roughly $500B in market value as AI capex hits earnings
lead.summary: Alphabet posted its worst day ever after a 25% profit drop and negative free cash flow driven by AI infrastructure spending. Amazon fell hard with trailing free cash flow at negative $42.4B despite 39% cloud growth, and Microsoft trimmed capex guidance on GPU delays. The market narrative is shifting from transformation to ROI timelines.

top_stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a proactive agent that messages you first
top_stories.summary: The research preview, open by waitlist to Pro and Max subscribers in the US, runs on a cloud computer powered by Opus 5.5 and sends a morning brief unprompted. It waits for approval before sending, paying, or signing anything.

top_stories.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra for fast, cheap computer use
top_stories.summary: Priced at $1/M input and $5/M output — roughly a tenth of GPT-6 Astra — with a 1.05M-token context. It scores 85.5% on MMMU-Pro vision at max effort but only 50.3% on Terminal-Bench 4.0.

top_stories.title: Banks pool $63B for Broadcom chips to lease to Anthropic
top_stories.summary: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley reportedly pooled $63 billion to buy Broadcom chips and lease them to Anthropic. Separately, Canada committed up to C$1.6 billion to Cohere tied to 1,000 jobs and domestic compute.

top_stories.title: Intel's woes wipe out $1 trillion of semiconductor market cap in one day
top_stories.summary: Intel shares plunged 30% after a disappointing outlook driven by an expected 20%+ drop in client computing sales, erasing about $150 billion — its largest single-day loss ever. The selloff spread across the industry, wiping out roughly $1 trillion in semiconductor market cap intraday.

items.title: 0.1% data poisoning backdoors coding agents through full post-training
items.summary: Poisoning just 0.1% of pretraining data creates persistent backdoors in Qwen3-style coding agents that survive clean SFT, DPO and RL stages — a serious risk for agentic deployments with shell access.

items.title: Gym-Anything: scaling robot simulation with digital agents
items.summary: Argues the bottleneck for robot simulation coverage is environment construction, and uses digital agents to generate realistic, fast physical simulations across a broad task range, enabling embodied training that transfers to the real world.

items.title: SCARL ties model confidence to verifier outcomes
items.summary: Confidence-aligned RLVR connects a policy's confidence in a sampled response to verifier outcomes, improving reasoning reliability beyond standard pass-based reward reinforcement.

items.title: L3G-World: real-time infinite world generation with latent 3D Gaussian memory
items.summary: Combines feed-forward reconstruction with latent video generation to enable real-time, long-horizon spatially consistent interactive world generation without growing RGB re-encoding costs.

items.title: RoPE coverage should be non-uniform across transformer layers
items.summary: Phase-off interventions reveal model-specific rotary-phase dependence, and profiling-guided layer-wise RoPE allocation improves positional coverage upgrades.

items.title: When closed-loop curriculum adaptation helps GRPO
items.summary: Analysis on Countdown shows clear sample-efficiency gains when the training distribution matches model capability via adaptive task selection.

items.title: RL post-trained Qwen3-27B agent model released open source, with an MLA variant
items.summary: The coding-agent model cuts hallucination on AA-Omniscience roughly in half (30.4% to 15.1%) and uses ~57% fewer output tokens on Terminal-Bench 2.1. The MLA variant compresses KV-cache ~72%, fitting long-running agents on a single 24GB GPU.

items.title: Sakana AI open-sources AI-Scientist-v3, an autonomous research pipeline
items.summary: A distributed pipeline using modern coding agents for end-to-end computational research: idea generation, sandboxed experiments, ablations, analysis and publication-ready figures via an AutoIllustrate agent.

items.title: Lafa turns pretrained LLMs into flow language models for 2.5x faster inference
items.summary: Drafts multiple tokens in parallel via embedding denoising, then verifies with the model's own next-token prediction — up to 2.54x faster generation on 7B-scale models with near-zero accuracy loss and light training.

items.title: Together AI showcases agentic RL post-training platform for open models
items.summary: Long multi-turn tool interactions, async generation, custom environments and rewards: users bring the setup, Together runs the training on open models.

items.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open 30B speech model
items.summary: The open-weight 30B MoE (~4B active) transcribes 40 languages, translates 31 to and from English, and separates up to eight speakers — first on the Open ASR leaderboard for open models at 4.71% mean WER. Recorded audio only, no live streams.

items.title: Roblox expands creator tooling with Web Play, Scene Generation and Prompt-to-Avatar betas
items.summary: The October 26-30 weekly recap confirms expanded creator testing and prototyping across four new betas.

items.title: mobile-agent lets AI agents control real Android and iOS devices
items.summary: An open-source tool that hands agents control of real phones, opening the door to mobile app testing and on-device automation.

items.title: fast-forced-aligner: CUDA alignment kernels 10x-1000x faster
items.summary: Optimized CUDA kernels for forced alignment in speech pipelines, claiming 10x to 1000x speedups over existing implementations.

items.title: Palomino: an ultrafast Rust-based agent workspace
items.summary: An open agent workspace written in Rust, pitched as an ultrafast environment for running and coordinating AI agent work locally.

items.title: Serval raises $150M Series C at $3B valuation for enterprise coding agents
items.summary: Led by Sequoia Capital. The San Francisco company, founded in 2024, builds coding agents for enterprise automation.

items.title: Salesforce acquires defense-logistics AI startup Rune for $375M
items.summary: Rune builds AI software predicting military supply needs; Salesforce extends its Missionforce defense unit, up 80% year-over-year on a large U.S. Army contract. Rune had raised $30M from a16z, Point72 Ventures and IQT.

items.title: Hex Technologies raises $100M at a $1.2B valuation
items.summary: New financing led by Peak XV and 137 Ventures for the AI-native data analytics platform.

items.title: Foundry Robotics raises $100M Series A for autonomous factories
items.summary: Led by Marlinspike. The Emeryville, CA company builds and operates autonomous factories.
